The forest on the property was observed to have significant tree-cover loss in 2021, with 81.3 hectares affected, which is about 2.23% of the asset. The majority of this area (68.1 hectares) was planted forest, specifically Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda. Additionally, there was some loss in smaller patches (under 0.5 ha) totaling 37.3 hectares, which was not counted as a separate event.

The latest observation year in the data is 2025, and there is no indication of further significant tree-cover loss after 2021. Therefore, based on the available data, it appears that the forest clearing on this property is not currently ongoing.
